# Managed versions: the one place the versions of dbt, dlt, their adapters and our
# vibedata-* units are chosen. Hand-edited, PEP 508, one requirement per line.
#
# This file fixes a version; it never causes a package to be installed. Every install
# site names the packages it needs and installs with `-c` against the effective file
# (`scripts/runtime_pins.py --platform <platform>`). Entries are one set that must
# install together on every site's Python: run `npm run check:runtime-resolve` from
# tests/evals after any edit. A platform that needs a different version of a package
# already listed here carries that one line in overrides/<platform>.txt.
#
# Design: docs/design/runtime-versions/README.md

# Engines and adapters.
dbt-core==1.12.5
dbt-fabric==1.11.1
dbt-fabricspark==1.13.6
dbt-duckdb==1.11.0
dbt-redshift==1.11.1
dbt-bigquery==1.12.1
dlt==1.30.0

# Databricks moves as one set with dlt: the adapter, the SDK and the SQL connector all
# refresh through the SDK, so a bump to any member re-runs the Databricks acceptance run.
# dbt-databricks 1.12.5 caps dbt-core below 1.12.4; 1.12.6 is the first release that
# allows the dbt-core the Fabric notebooks run.
dbt-databricks==1.12.6
databricks-sdk==0.117.0
databricks-sql-connector==4.4.0

# Snowflake moves as one set with dlt and dbt-core: the adapter and the Python connector
# are the versions spiked together (dbt-snowflake 1.12.1 and connector 4.8.0 against
# dbt-core 1.12.5 and dlt 1.30.0). The connector's `token_file_path` and dlt's token-file
# mode are version-specific behaviours, so a bump to either re-runs the Snowflake contract tests.
dbt-snowflake==1.12.1
snowflake-connector-python==4.8.0

# Our units.
vibedata-dbt-fabric-notebook==0.2.1
vibedata-dlt-core==0.6.0
vibedata-dlt-fabric-notebook==0.10.0
vibedata-dlt-fabric-studio==0.18.1
vibedata-dlt-fabric-warehouse-studio==0.5.0
vibedata-dlt-duckdb-studio==0.11.0
vibedata-dlt-studio-secrets==0.2.0
vibedata-studio-azure-cred-broker==0.1.4

# A floor rather than a pin, so a later release reaches the next image build and Domain
# CI install without an edit here. 0.2.0 is the first release that logs in as the user
# the Broker's `database_password` answer names rather than the projected one (VD-6189).
vibedata-dlt-redshift-studio>=0.2.0

# MotherDuck refuses a client older than this. The agent image still installs the exact
# version MotherDuck certifies at build time (its workflow resolves it); this is only
# the floor every other consumer honours.
duckdb>=1.5.5
